$comment: framework, buildCommand and outputDirectory are stated here on purpose. The previous vercel.json set framework:null with buildCommand 'node build.mjs' and outputDirectory 'public', and Vercel keeps those in the project's own settings once it has seen them. build.mjs no longer exists, so a deployment that falls back to the dashboard values dies before it starts. Values in this file override the dashboard, which makes the build reproducible from the repository rather than from a settings page nobody can diff.
